# Porvenir Agencia Digital

> Software Engineering, Web Design & AI agency. We don't use slow templates — we build profitable, bespoke digital assets.

## Overview
Porvenir Agencia Digital, based in Ciudad Real (Spain), bridges the gap between Software Engineering, Web Design, and Artificial Intelligence to scale businesses. Led by Teresa Rodríguez de Dios (Software Engineer & UX Expert), the agency delivers three core services: bespoke web design with UX, AI automation and chatbots, and mobile app development. Projects across Spain and internationally, fully remote.

## Core Services
- **Web Design & UX (Diseño Web & UX):** Bespoke, ultra-fast, Mobile First websites with Technical SEO built with semantic HTML, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript — no templates, no plugins, strategically designed to maximise conversions. UX strategy and WCAG 2.1 accessibility audits are included as standard, because a well-built website both converts and complies with the law. This website (porveniragenciadigital.com) is itself a product of the agency.
- **AI & Automation (IA & Automatización):** Intelligent chatbots for WhatsApp and web, autonomous AI voice agents that answer, qualify, and route incoming calls 24/7, and bespoke automation flows for any business process. The key solution for compliance with Spain's Ley 10/2025 de Atención a la Clientela (Law 10/2025), which requires answering 95% of calls in under 3 minutes — without expanding headcount.
- **Mobile Apps (Apps Móviles):** Native and hybrid iOS and Android applications built with software engineering rigour: clean architecture, AI integration, external APIs, and CRM connections. From business analysis and UX design through to production launch.

## Key Technical Differentiators
- **Engineering Foundation:** All projects are approached from a software engineering perspective — performance, scalability, and maintainable code, not just visual aesthetics.
- **UX-First Strategy:** Every technical solution is validated through User Experience principles and conversion architecture.
- **Legal Compliance Expertise:** Specialized in Spain's Ley 10/2025 (Atención a la Clientela), WCAG 2.1 accessibility, LOPD/GDPR, and EU AI Act alignment.
- **Full-Stack Ownership:** Design, build, and delivery handled by the same engineer — no fragmented handoffs.

## Key Personnel
- **Teresa Rodríguez de Dios:** Founder, Software Engineer & MSc in User Experience Design. 📍 Ciudad Real, España (Global service).
